title: feat(nm2frm2lys): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e2 at t+1 on two-axis same-lock seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,-e2) on the same-lock seed. The four probe bits are fail,HOLD,fail,HOLD - the only 'checkerboard' probe pattern in the band, caused by same-lock killing (0,0,1) and a two-in at (0,0,-1).
